about: Younited (formerly Younited Credit) is a Paris-based European consumer credit and open banking fintech, founded in 2009, offering personal loans, pay-by-bank and instalment payments in countries like France, Italy, Spain, Portugal and Germany, and holds a French banking licence. Crunchbase shows about 880 million euros in funding including debt facilities. A brand with moderate consumer reach in southern Europe.

Pinnacle Financial Partners is a Nashville, Tennessee bank holding company with Pinnacle Bank, providing commercial and consumer banking, wealth management and mortgage services across Tennessee and the Southeast US. Its total assets are around 50 billion dollars after merging with Synovus in 2026. Pinnacle is listed on Nasdaq (PNFP) and is known for its employee-focused culture and as a regular entrant in best-places-to-work lists. It is a regional bank brand with a strong presence in the US South.

about: Sedgwick is a Memphis-based claims management and risk services company, handling property and casualty, workers' compensation, disability and product recall claims for corporations, insurers and public-sector clients, with around 30,000 colleagues in 80 countries and revenue of roughly $4 billion. Privately held, with Carlyle and Stone Point Capital as major investors. B2B insurer-service brand with modest profile.

Banco Sabadell is a Spanish banking group, founded in 1881 in Sabadell, Catalonia, with headquarters moved to Alicante in 2017, providing retail, SME, corporate and private banking, insurance and TSB in the UK (acquired 2015). It has about 20,000 employees and operates in Spain, the UK and Mexico, with assets of more than 250 billion euros. Listed on the Spanish stock exchange (SAB). In 2024-2025 it rejected a takeover bid from BBVA. Consumer banking brand with strong Spanish recognition and sponsorships in sport.

wiki.title: Banco Sabadell
wiki.text: Banco de Sabadell, S.A. is a Spanish multinational financial services company headquartered in Sabadell, Catalonia. It is the 4th-largest Spanish banking group. It includes several banks, brands, subsidiaries and associated banks. It is a universal bank and specialises in serving small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and the affluent with a bias towards international trade.

about: Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI) is a Jakarta-based Indonesian state-owned bank, listed on the IDX (BBNI), one of the four largest banks in the country with retail, SME and corporate customers and branches abroad. Founded in 1946. Strong consumer brand in Indonesia and a known sports sponsor there.

wiki.title: Bank Negara Indonesia
wiki.text: PT Bank Negara Indonesia (Persero) Tbk is an Indonesian state-owned bank. It has branches primarily in Indonesia, but it can also be found in Seoul, Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Amsterdam, London and New York. It had 1,834 domestic branches, six overseas branches, two representative offices, one overseas sub-branch, and one remittance branch and more than 63 million customers in 2021. It is listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange as "BBNI".

about: Morpho is a Paris-based decentralized lending network and DeFi protocol on which users can lend, borrow and build vaults on blockchains such as Ethereum and Base. Founded in 2021, it makes money from protocol and vault fees and raised about 244 million dollars from investors including a16z crypto and Ribbit. Partners include Coinbase and Crypto.com. Known to crypto users, with little mainstream consumer awareness.

Athene is a West Des Moines, Iowa-based US retirement services company, now part of Apollo Global Management (merged in 2022), which sells fixed annuities and funding agreements and reinsures, with more than $300 billion in assets. Customers are retirees, institutions and employers. Previously listed on NYSE (ATH). Corporate brand known in insurance, but low general consumer awareness.

Napster, formerly Infinite Reality, is a US company focused on immersive 3D and AI-enabled websites, digital media and commerce. In 2025 Infinite Reality acquired the Napster music brand, and the combined company now operates as Napster. Crunchbase shows about $3.35 billion in total funding, a figure to treat with caution. Customers are brands, creators and consumers. Crunchbase lists Norwalk, Connecticut. Napster is a recognised consumer name from its music streaming history.

about: Zurich-based insurtech founded in 2015 in Germany by Julian Teicke, selling insurance products through its digital platform and broker network to consumers and small businesses across Europe. Valued at about $4.5 billion in 2021 and restructured, with units sold, after 2023. Consumer brand in Germany and some other European markets. Wefox also runs a sales network and digital brand, and it has offices in Germany, Austria and Switzerland.

Prismic Life Reinsurance is a life and annuity reinsurance company based in Hamilton, Bermuda, in the asset management and insurance sector. Funding shown is about 2.9 billion dollars, which probably reflects capital raised to back reinsured blocks. Its owners and clients are not detailed in the input. B2B financial business. about: Fortitude Re is a reinsurance company with roots in Bermuda and operations in the US, with a Jersey City office, formed in 2018 as a spin-out from AIG and now majority-owned by Carlyle and T&D Holdings. It takes over blocks of life and annuity business from insurers, and manages tens of billions of dollars of reserves. B2B with little public brand awareness.

Truist Insurance Holdings was the insurance brokerage subsidiary of Truist Financial, based in Charlotte, North Carolina, owning McGriff Insurance Services and other brokers, and valued at about $15 billion in a 2024 deal. Truist sold a majority stake to a Stone Point Capital and CD&R led group in 2024, and the business was renamed McGriff Insurance Services. Provides commercial and personal insurance brokerage. Brand awareness is regional.

Aspen Insurance Holdings is a Bermuda-based specialty insurance and reinsurance group with operations in Bermuda, London and the US, writing property, casualty, specialty and reinsurance for businesses globally. Listed on the NYSE under AHL, it has long been a Lloyd's market participant and was previously owned by Apollo funds. Japan's Sompo agreed in 2025 to acquire it for about $3.5 billion. B2B insurer with little consumer awareness. Funding shown is about $1.15 billion.

The Automobile Association (AA) is a British motoring organisation founded in 1905, based in Basingstoke, providing breakdown cover, insurance, driving lessons and route services to about 3 million members. It was listed on the LSE in 2014, then bought in 2021 by TowerBrook and Warburg Pincus for about 2.7 billion pounds. Famous UK consumer brand with yellow vans, and a familiar sponsor in motorsport.

LendInvest is a UK property finance company that provides buy-to-let mortgages and short-term bridging and development loans, using a digital platform and funded by institutional and retail investors. Headquartered in London; founded 2008. Funding shown is around 4.1 billion dollars, likely including debt lines. Originated billions of pounds of loans. Privately held, with a small bond listing. Known to landlords and property investors, with a limited consumer profile.

about: Brookfield is a Toronto and New York-based global alternative asset manager (Brookfield Corporation and Brookfield Asset Management, NYSE/TSX: BN, BAM), managing over $1 trillion in assets in infrastructure, renewable power, real estate, private equity and credit. Founded in 1899. Investors are pensions, sovereigns and individuals. Corporate brand known in finance; it owns brands via real estate (Brookfield Place) and investments such as Westinghouse.

Brookfield Asset Management is one of the world's largest alternative asset managers, with over 1 trillion dollars of assets under management across renewable power, infrastructure, real estate, private equity and credit. Headquartered in Toronto and listed on the NYSE and TSX (BAM), it was separated from Brookfield Corporation in 2022. Clients are pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, insurers and private investors, and it earns management and carry fees. Portfolio companies include many well-known assets. Institutional brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Brookfield Asset Management
wiki.text: Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. is the US-based subsidiary of Canadian-based asset manager, Brookfield Corporation. The company was founded in December 2022 as a spin-off of the asset management operations of Brookfield Corporation, and manages investments across real estate, infrastructure, renewable energy, private equity, and credit markets globally. Brookfield Asset Management is run by CEO Connor Teskey, who succeeded Bruce Flatt in February 2026.

about: MidOcean Energy is a global LNG company formed in 2023 by EIG, an energy investment firm, as a platform for LNG liquefaction and regasification investments. It focuses on acquiring interests in LNG liquefaction and related gas assets. Headquartered in Washington, DC, it is privately owned and sells LNG to utilities and energy traders. B2B energy investor with no consumer profile.

about: Victory Capital is a US asset management firm headquartered in San Antonio, Texas, listed on Nasdaq (VCTR), that owns multiple independent investment franchises and manages around 300 billion dollars in mutual funds, ETFs and separate accounts. It sells through financial advisers and institutions and has grown by acquiring firms such as USAA Asset Management and Amundi US. Founded as a KeyCorp unit and independent since 2013. B2B financial brand with low consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Victory Capital
wiki.text: Victory Capital Holdings, Inc. is an American financial services company headquartered in San Antonio, Texas that focuses on investment management. Outside the US, it also has investment professionals in London, Hong Kong and Singapore.

about: Western Union is a global money transfer company, enabling consumers to send money across more than 200 countries and territories through agents, retail locations, online and its app, plus business payments. Revenue is about $4 billion from transfer fees and foreign exchange. Headquartered in Denver, Colorado, and founded in 1851 as a telegraph company. Listed on NYSE (WU). In 2025 it agreed to acquire Intermex. Very recognisable global consumer brand, particularly among migrant communities.

wiki.title: Western Union
wiki.text: The Western Union Company is an American multinational financial services corporation headquartered in Denver, Colorado.

about: CI Financial is a Toronto-based wealth and asset management company offering mutual funds, advisory and wealth services in Canada, the US and Australia through CI Global Asset Management, Corient and others, with hundreds of billions of dollars under management and administration. Customers are retail investors and advisors, with revenue from management fees. Taken private in 2025 by a Mubadala Capital-led investor group, previously listed on the TSX (CIX). Known among Canadian investors.

wiki.title: CI Financial
wiki.text: CI Financial is a Canadian investment management company based in Toronto, Ontario. It offers investment management and wealth management services targeted to high net worth retail investors, as well as brokerage and trading services to portfolio managers and institutional investors.
